questions.prompt: Why delete the cached copy on a write instead of updating it?

options: Leases: a delete invalidates the reader's token, so its set is refused
Every write pays for both stores, and a failure between them leaves them disagreeing
It can't be used with databases

options: Acknowledged writes are lost if the cache node dies before flushing

questions.prompt: Which pattern suits log entries written once and rarely read soon after?
